newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai attracts $11 bln foreign funds in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai attracts $11 bln foreign funds in 1996.

text.p: Shanghai attracted $11 billion in contracted foreign investment in 1996, up five percent from 1995 and the third year in a row that the total topped $10 billion, the Business News said on Friday.
The newspaper said $4.7 billion in foreign funds were actually invested in projects in the city last year, an increase of 44.6 percent over 1995.
By the end of 1996, Shanghai had attracted total foreign investment of $45.3 billion, it added.
The Shanghai city government approved 2,106 foreign-invested projects in 1996, down 26 percent from 1995, the newspaper said.
